notes: Strip e: x 5480-7620 plus overlap 5180-7920. Plate content in this strip only reaches y~3650 (railroad yards and the Ohio below y~2300; nothing pickable south of the railroad street). A paper seam runs N-S at x~5370 from the top to y~3600 (west side lots are a different subdivision; State Avenue's west line is just east of the seam in the north and on/over it from y~1500 south). Many interior lines in the streets are tracks, sewers and pipes; centres taken between block lines (addresses are printed inside the street next to the block). Burns has no suffix printed (recorded bare 'Burns'); Saint Michael printed 'ST. MICHAEL'. The diagonal street along the railroad from the State/Neave junction NE past Church, Burns and on ENE to Evans (where W. Sixth Street begins on the east side) carries only 'STREET' (x~6830-7080) - recorded '?'; it may be English Street continued (English bends into it, numbering 21xx -> 1964-1940) or W. Sixth Street extended - not resolved from the plate. Large spaced letters ('S T O R R S', 'C I T Y', 'B. ... S') are subdivision lettering, not street names. Not streets: B. & O. railroad and yards, the 30-in sewer line at x~5600 below y~2700, coloured boundary bands (blue/yellow/teal/pink), the private lot lines with fences (x~7055).
